claims.text: Pivot-based methods are a strategy to obtain a source to target model by introducing a pivot language.
Pivoting translates a source language to a pivot language and then to a target language, which can lead to inefficiencies and error propagation.
Pivot-based methods are considered strong baselines in zero-shot translation scenarios, often outperforming other methods like multilingual NMT.
